title: Homogeneous multiplication for exact graded data
statement: For every TensorGradedPresentation j L, multiplication of the images of homogeneous sections in degrees a and d equals the image in degree a+d under the inverse tensor-power addition isomorphism.

proof.text: Project the b_multiply field of T.

proof_origin.place: N1 repair X-f9ba3: field-projection proof from TensorGradedPresentation.b_multiply

mathlib_searches.query: graded tensor presentation square zero ideal

lean.statement: theorem tensorGradedPresentation_core_multiply {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (T : TensorGradedPresentation j L) : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a d : ℕ) (s : Γ(L.tensorPow a, U)) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow d, U)), tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b a).app U s) * tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b d).app U t) = tensorGradedAlgebraSection T.B U ((T.b (a + d)).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso a d).inv.app U (tmulSection s t)))

statement_change.old_statement: For every TensorGradedPresentationCore j L, multiplication of the images of homogeneous sections in degrees a and d equals the image in degree a+d under the inverse tensor-power addition isomorphism.
statement_change.what: The arbitrary-core assertion is false: for the identity immersion on Spec Q and L = O, twice the homogeneous inclusions with half coefficient projections satisfy the core fields, but degree-zero multiplication asserts 4 = 2. As requested in return X-f9ba3, require the full presentation and project its b_multiply field. This corrects an intermediate API, not a target statement.

citers.note: The delivered full-presentation existence proof constructs the multiplication field directly from A.b_multiply and removes this dependency; it no longer applies the invalid arbitrary-core assertion.

old_proof.text: On each frame open multiplication is multiplication of polynomial coefficients; transition functions preserve the formula, so the local identities glue and sheaf separation gives the global section identity.
